g.text: , wherever the unit comes from (drawn, or found by software) and never reused. Its
is what people see: the roster gives one as the unit joins, and never gives it again. Deleting unit 3 and drawing it again makes a new key, so the loop runs it as unit 4.
Stopped or cut short, the loop leaves its scratch. Starting it again in that folder replays the scratch and carries on: each routine from its history, each unit from where it was last found.
